"""Owner-authorized model-free V2 selection replay against pinned ancestry."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'training/src'))
HERE = ROOT / 'training/phase3/copy-fidelity-v1'
def module(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    result = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(result)
    return result
v2 = module('v2_search', HERE / 'review_namespace_diversity_v2.py')
audit = module('v2_audit', HERE / 'audit_v2_ancestor_history.py')
sha = lambda raw: hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
inventory = ROOT / 'training/pretraining/p3-sb03-v2-ancestor-training-text-inventory.json'
assert sha(inventory.read_bytes()) == '111784c169f9d180b8ec5329de7acda9f0259214847136a7fab3684ce24b58d1'
original_v2 = audit.PROPOSAL
assert sha(original_v2.read_bytes()) == audit.EXPECTED_V2_SHA256
files = audit._inventory(inventory)
history = []
shas = {}
for item in files:
    raw = Path(item['path']).read_bytes()
    assert sha(raw) == item['sha256']
    history.append(raw.lower())
    shas[item['path']] = item['sha256']
print('Verified ten recorded ancestor files; beginning bounded case-insensitive search.', flush=True)
limit = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 2500
receipt, proposal = v2.search(v2.tokenizer_from_file(), attempts_per_slot=limit,
                            extra_history=history, extra_history_shas=shas)
out = ROOT / f'.test-artifacts/v2-history-selection-replay-{limit}.json'
with out.open('xb') as fp:
    fp.write(v2.V1._canonical(receipt))
if proposal is not None:
    (ROOT / '.test-artifacts/v2-history-selection-draft.json').write_bytes(v2.V1._canonical(proposal))
print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in receipt.items() if k != 'slotResults'}, indent=2))
print(json.dumps(receipt['slotResults'], indent=2))
